content:
TEMPTATION ||| Grip the Answer tighter, leaning closer to Julian's face. ||| "What if I told you I did?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, letting the Answer hang between us. ||| "I won't answer until I know what was done."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze directly, breath catching. ||| "I wanted to believe I was innocent."  
REVERSAL ||| Lift the Answer, asserting control over the moment. ||| "I will decide how this unfolds, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Hold my breath, letting the tension fill the air. |||
